purpose: Describe someone making no attempt or showing no willingness to act.
keywords: Verb volitional form + としない
My younger brother will not even try to eat vegetables.
He made no attempt to explain the reason.
The dog will not come out of its kennel.
formation: Verb volitional form + としない
restrictions: Commonly describes another person’s observable unwillingness, rather than inability.
mistake: Compare ようとする, which marks an attempt or an imminent action.
